extracted.name: Cranberry Punch
extracted.description: Cranberry-apple juice mixed with ginger ale and garnished with slices of lime and sprigs of mint.
instruction_lines: Half-fill 6 tall glasses with ice. Fill to about three quarters with cranberry-apple juice. Pour ginger ale evenly into the glasses. Stir gently. Decorate with lime and mint sprigs.
